title: Your decks in {year}
description: Counts across your own decks created or changed in the year you pick. Each figure links to the decks behind it. Nothing here compares you with other players.
loadFailed: Your statistics could not be loaded.
empty: No deck was created or changed in {year}.
noCommanderDecks: No Commander deck was created or changed in {year}, so there are no colour, commander, card or bracket figures.
ofDecks: {count, number} of {total, plural, one {# deck} other {# decks}}
atLeastOfDecks: at least {count, number} of {total, plural, one {# deck} other {# decks}}

cardsUsedMost.caption: The ten cards you use most
cardsUsedMost.note: Basic lands are left out. A card counts once per deck, whatever its number of copies.

shared.caption: Cards shared across decks
shared.summary: {count, plural, one {# card sits} other {# cards sit}} in two or more of your {total, plural, one {# Commander deck} other {# Commander decks}}. The five most shared:

brackets.caption: Brackets
brackets.comboNote: Estimates do not check two-card combos, so a deck that holds one may belong in a higher bracket.

activity.caption: Decks added and changed
activity.note: A deck counts as changed when it was saved or snapshotted in the year. Only its last save is kept, so changed decks are a floor.
